title: 第5章 斩草除根灭宗门第6章 挑战宗主巅峰对决
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
连续两天时间，楚云都盘坐在院中炼化体内吸收的玄力。
而他的修为，也在不知不觉中，从地武境一重提升到了地武境五重。
在此期间，楚啸天也来看过楚云。
发现楚云依然闭目修炼后，他没有打扰，而是让人继续给楚云护法。
当第三天来临时，楚云缓缓睁开眼睛。
经过三天的修炼，他终于将体内的玄力全部炼化。
此时他的修为，停留在了地武境五重巅峰。
只差一步就进入地武境六重！
“不错，吸收这十个老家伙的修为，一下就提升了四重修为，不过以后吞噬玄武境，估计对修为作用不大了，要吸收至少也要吸收地武境武者的修为。”
感受到楚云的修为再次提升，镜灵露出激动之色。
就在这时，楚啸天走了过来。
当看见楚云睁开眼睛后，他一脸关心地问道：“云儿，你没事吧？”
见到楚啸天一脸关心，楚云心中升起一阵暖流。
尽管从小不能修炼，被别人当成废物，但楚啸天依然没有放弃他，反而想尽各种办法帮助他修炼。
“爹，我没事。”
楚云露出一抹微笑。
“没事就好，快起来，你现在是我们楚家的大英雄，族人们都在大厅等你。”
“好。”
听到这话，楚云跟着楚啸天朝着大厅走去。
只见楚家几位族老，还有一些嫡系族人，已经等候在里面。

“大少爷来了。”
随着这话响起，所有族人都站了起来。
他们看着楚云眼中有激动，有崇拜。
楚云凭借一己之力，不但杀死王李两家家主，还杀死太玄宗十位执法长老。
可以说这种战绩，至今他们楚家没有人能够做到。
“见过诸位叔叔伯伯。”
楚云朝着几位年长的族老拱手行礼。
“楚云，快坐。”
“对，你快告诉我们，你是如何做到，在这么短的时间内成为地武境强者。”
几位族老面带笑容，将他围了起来。
楚家出了一位地武境强者，对他们来说是楚家的荣耀。
“对，爹也很想知道，你是怎么修炼到地武境，你去太玄宗才三年时间，就算青州第一天才段惊天，也没有你这个修炼速度。”
楚啸天看着楚云也是一脸好奇。
面对族人和楚啸天期待的眼神，他自然不会将自己拥有青铜古镜的事说出来。
而是谎称自己无意中吃了一颗丹药，然后修为就突飞猛进。
听到这话，众人虽然有些不相信，但是似乎找不到更好的理由解释。
content_en:
For two consecutive days, Chu Yun sat cross-legged in the courtyard to refine the profound energy absorbed in his body.
And his cultivation level also unknowingly improved from the first level of the Earth Martial Realm to the fifth level of the Earth Martial Realm.
During this period, Chu Xiaotian also visited Chu Yun.
After discovering that Chu Yun was still practicing with his eyes closed, he did not disturb him, but asked someone to continue to protect Chu Yun.
When the third day came, Chu Yun slowly opened his eyes.
After three days of practice, he finally refined all the profound energy in his body.
At this time, his cultivation level was at the peak of the fifth level of Earth Martial Realm.
Only one step away from entering the sixth level of the Earth Martial Realm!
"Yes, absorbing the cultivation of these ten old guys will improve your cultivation by four levels at once. However, in the future, swallowing the Xuanwu realm will probably have little effect on your cultivation. To absorb it, you must at least absorb the cultivation of the Earth Martial Realm warriors."
Feeling that Chu Yun's cultivation had improved again, Jing Ling showed excitement.
At this moment, Chu Xiaotian came over.
When he saw Chu Yun open his eyes, he asked with concern: "Yun'er, are you okay?"
Seeing Chu Xiaotian's concerned face, Chu Yun felt warm in his heart.
Although he was unable to practice since he was a child and was treated as a waste by others, Chu Xiaotian still did not give up on him. Instead, he tried every means to help him practice.
"Dad, I'm fine."
Chu Yun showed a smile.
"It's okay. Get up quickly. You are now the great hero of our Chu family. Everyone is waiting for you in the hall."
"Okay."
Upon hearing this, Chu Yun followed Chu Xiaotian towards the hall.
Several elders of the Chu family and some direct clan members were seen waiting inside.
"The young master is here."
As these words were heard, all the clan members stood up.
They looked at Chu Yun with excitement and admiration in his eyes.
With his own power, Chu Yun not only killed the heads of the Wang and Li families, but also killed ten law enforcement elders of Taixuan Sect.
It can be said that no one in the Chu family has been able to achieve this kind of achievement so far.
"I've met all your uncles."
Chu Yun bowed his hands in salute to several elders.
"Chu Yun, sit down quickly."
"Yes, please tell us how you did it and became a strong person in the Earth Martial Realm in such a short period of time."
Several clan elders surrounded him with smiles on their faces.
The Chu family gave birth to a strong man in the Earth Martial Realm, which was the glory of the Chu family to them.
"Yes, Dad also wants to know how you cultivated to the Earth Martial Realm. You have only been in Taixuan Sect for three years. Even Duan Jingtian, the number one genius in Qingzhou, cannot cultivate as fast as you."
Chu Xiaotian looked at Chu Yun with curiosity.
Facing the expectant looks in his clansman's and Chu Xiaotian's eyes, he naturally would not tell anyone about his possession of the ancient bronze mirror.
Instead, he lied that he accidentally took a pill, and then his cultivation level improved by leaps and bounds.
After hearing this, everyone didn't believe it, but they couldn't seem to find a better reason to explain.
